BEGIN;

INSERT INTO learning_goal_version(
    goal_code, version, graph_version, title, description, status, published_at
) VALUES (
    'programming.foundation', 'v1', 'programming-foundation-graph-v1', 'Основы программирования',
    'Language-neutral foundations for understanding and constructing small programs.',
    'PUBLISHED', now()
)
ON CONFLICT (goal_code, version) DO NOTHING;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM learning_goal_version
        WHERE goal_code = 'programming.foundation'
          AND version = 'v1'
          AND graph_version = 'programming-foundation-graph-v1'
          AND title = 'Основы программирования'
          AND description = 'Language-neutral foundations for understanding and constructing small programs.'
          AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
          AND published_at IS NOT NULL
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'programming.foundation v1 conflicts with the required published graph identity';
    END IF;
END $$;

INSERT INTO learning_target(target_type, target_key, target_version, title, description) VALUES
    ('concept', 'programming.execution-state', 'v1', 'Execution and state', 'Trace how a program advances and how its state changes.'),
    ('concept', 'programming.values-expressions', 'v1', 'Values and expressions', 'Build and evaluate expressions from typed values and operations.'),
    ('concept', 'programming.control-flow', 'v1', 'Control flow', 'Reason about selection, repetition, and termination.'),
    ('capability', 'programming.functions-decomposition', 'v1', 'Functions and decomposition', 'Decompose behavior into named functions with explicit inputs and outputs.'),
    ('capability', 'programming.collections-iteration', 'v1', 'Collections and iteration', 'Process collections with explicit iteration and state updates.'),
    ('capability', 'programming.debugging-feedback', 'v1', 'Debugging and feedback', 'Observe behavior, test assumptions, and use feedback to correct a program.')
ON CONFLICT (target_type, target_key, target_version) DO NOTHING;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF (
        SELECT count(*)
        FROM learning_target actual
        JOIN (VALUES
            ('concept', 'programming.execution-state', 'v1', 'Execution and state', 'Trace how a program advances and how its state changes.'),
            ('concept', 'programming.values-expressions', 'v1', 'Values and expressions', 'Build and evaluate expressions from typed values and operations.'),
            ('concept', 'programming.control-flow', 'v1', 'Control flow', 'Reason about selection, repetition, and termination.'),
            ('capability', 'programming.functions-decomposition', 'v1', 'Functions and decomposition', 'Decompose behavior into named functions with explicit inputs and outputs.'),
            ('capability', 'programming.collections-iteration', 'v1', 'Collections and iteration', 'Process collections with explicit iteration and state updates.'),
            ('capability', 'programming.debugging-feedback', 'v1', 'Debugging and feedback', 'Observe behavior, test assumptions, and use feedback to correct a program.')
        ) AS expected(target_type, target_key, target_version, title, description)
          ON actual.target_type = expected.target_type
         AND actual.target_key = expected.target_key
         AND actual.target_version = expected.target_version
         AND actual.title = expected.title
         AND actual.description = expected.description
    ) <> 6 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'programming.foundation target identities conflict with the required neutral catalog';
    END IF;
END $$;

INSERT INTO learning_goal_target(
    goal_code, goal_version, target_type, target_key, target_version,
    module_code, module_title, module_order,
    section_code, section_title, section_order,
    lesson_code, lesson_title, lesson_excerpt, lesson_order
) VALUES
    ('programming.foundation', 'v1', 'concept', 'programming.execution-state', 'v1',
     'program-model', 'Program model', 0, 'execution', 'Execution', 0,
     'execution-state', 'Execution and state', 'Follow program execution and identify each state change.', 0),
    ('programming.foundation', 'v1', 'concept', 'programming.values-expressions', 'v1',
     'program-model', 'Program model', 0, 'values', 'Values', 1,
     'values-expressions', 'Values and expressions', 'Combine values with operations and predict expression results.', 0),
    ('programming.foundation', 'v1', 'concept', 'programming.control-flow', 'v1',
     'program-model', 'Program model', 0, 'control', 'Control', 2,
     'control-flow', 'Control flow', 'Use conditions and repetition to direct execution.', 0),
    ('programming.foundation', 'v1', 'capability', 'programming.functions-decomposition', 'v1',
     'program-construction', 'Program construction', 1, 'decomposition', 'Decomposition', 0,
     'functions-decomposition', 'Functions and decomposition', 'Split behavior into small explicit functions.', 0),
    ('programming.foundation', 'v1', 'capability', 'programming.collections-iteration', 'v1',
     'program-construction', 'Program construction', 1, 'data-processing', 'Data processing', 1,
     'collections-iteration', 'Collections and iteration', 'Transform collections through controlled iteration.', 0),
    ('programming.foundation', 'v1', 'capability', 'programming.debugging-feedback', 'v1',
     'program-construction', 'Program construction', 1, 'feedback', 'Feedback', 2,
     'debugging-feedback', 'Debugging and feedback', 'Use observations and tests to locate and correct faults.', 0)
ON CONFLICT (goal_code, goal_version, target_type, target_key, target_version) DO NOTHING;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF (SELECT count(*) FROM learning_goal_target WHERE goal_code = 'programming.foundation' AND goal_version = 'v1') <> 6 OR (
        SELECT count(*)
        FROM learning_goal_target actual
        JOIN (VALUES
            ('concept', 'programming.execution-state', 'v1', 'program-model', 'Program model', 0, 'execution', 'Execution', 0, 'execution-state', 'Execution and state', 'Follow program execution and identify each state change.', 0),
            ('concept', 'programming.values-expressions', 'v1', 'program-model', 'Program model', 0, 'values', 'Values', 1, 'values-expressions', 'Values and expressions', 'Combine values with operations and predict expression results.', 0),
            ('concept', 'programming.control-flow', 'v1', 'program-model', 'Program model', 0, 'control', 'Control', 2, 'control-flow', 'Control flow', 'Use conditions and repetition to direct execution.', 0),
            ('capability', 'programming.functions-decomposition', 'v1', 'program-construction', 'Program construction', 1, 'decomposition', 'Decomposition', 0, 'functions-decomposition', 'Functions and decomposition', 'Split behavior into small explicit functions.', 0),
            ('capability', 'programming.collections-iteration', 'v1', 'program-construction', 'Program construction', 1, 'data-processing', 'Data processing', 1, 'collections-iteration', 'Collections and iteration', 'Transform collections through controlled iteration.', 0),
            ('capability', 'programming.debugging-feedback', 'v1', 'program-construction', 'Program construction', 1, 'feedback', 'Feedback', 2, 'debugging-feedback', 'Debugging and feedback', 'Use observations and tests to locate and correct faults.', 0)
        ) AS expected(
            target_type, target_key, target_version, module_code, module_title, module_order,
            section_code, section_title, section_order, lesson_code, lesson_title, lesson_excerpt, lesson_order
        )
          ON actual.target_type = expected.target_type
         AND actual.target_key = expected.target_key
         AND actual.target_version = expected.target_version
         AND actual.module_code = expected.module_code
         AND actual.module_title = expected.module_title
         AND actual.module_order = expected.module_order
         AND actual.section_code = expected.section_code
         AND actual.section_title = expected.section_title
         AND actual.section_order = expected.section_order
         AND actual.lesson_code = expected.lesson_code
         AND actual.lesson_title = expected.lesson_title
         AND actual.lesson_excerpt = expected.lesson_excerpt
         AND actual.lesson_order = expected.lesson_order
        WHERE actual.goal_code = 'programming.foundation' AND actual.goal_version = 'v1'
    ) <> 6 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'programming.foundation v1 placement conflicts with the required graph';
    END IF;
END $$;

INSERT INTO target_prerequisite(
    target_type, target_key, target_version,
    prerequisite_type, prerequisite_key, prerequisite_version
) VALUES
    ('concept', 'programming.values-expressions', 'v1', 'concept', 'programming.execution-state', 'v1'),
    ('concept', 'programming.control-flow', 'v1', 'concept', 'programming.values-expressions', 'v1'),
    ('capability', 'programming.functions-decomposition', 'v1', 'concept', 'programming.control-flow', 'v1'),
    ('capability', 'programming.collections-iteration', 'v1', 'concept', 'programming.control-flow', 'v1'),
    ('capability', 'programming.debugging-feedback', 'v1', 'capability', 'programming.functions-decomposition', 'v1'),
    ('capability', 'programming.debugging-feedback', 'v1', 'capability', 'programming.collections-iteration', 'v1')
ON CONFLICT (
    target_type, target_key, target_version,
    prerequisite_type, prerequisite_key, prerequisite_version
) DO NOTHING;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT target_type, target_key, target_version,
               prerequisite_type, prerequisite_key, prerequisite_version
        FROM target_prerequisite
        WHERE (target_type, target_key, target_version) IN (
            ('concept', 'programming.execution-state', 'v1'),
            ('concept', 'programming.values-expressions', 'v1'),
            ('concept', 'programming.control-flow', 'v1'),
            ('capability', 'programming.functions-decomposition', 'v1'),
            ('capability', 'programming.collections-iteration', 'v1'),
            ('capability', 'programming.debugging-feedback', 'v1')
        )
        EXCEPT
        SELECT * FROM (VALUES
            ('concept', 'programming.values-expressions', 'v1', 'concept', 'programming.execution-state', 'v1'),
            ('concept', 'programming.control-flow', 'v1', 'concept', 'programming.values-expressions', 'v1'),
            ('capability', 'programming.functions-decomposition', 'v1', 'concept', 'programming.control-flow', 'v1'),
            ('capability', 'programming.collections-iteration', 'v1', 'concept', 'programming.control-flow', 'v1'),
            ('capability', 'programming.debugging-feedback', 'v1', 'capability', 'programming.functions-decomposition', 'v1'),
            ('capability', 'programming.debugging-feedback', 'v1', 'capability', 'programming.collections-iteration', 'v1')
        ) AS expected(target_type, target_key, target_version, prerequisite_type, prerequisite_key, prerequisite_version)
    ) OR EXISTS (
        SELECT * FROM (VALUES
            ('concept', 'programming.values-expressions', 'v1', 'concept', 'programming.execution-state', 'v1'),
            ('concept', 'programming.control-flow', 'v1', 'concept', 'programming.values-expressions', 'v1'),
            ('capability', 'programming.functions-decomposition', 'v1', 'concept', 'programming.control-flow', 'v1'),
            ('capability', 'programming.collections-iteration', 'v1', 'concept', 'programming.control-flow', 'v1'),
            ('capability', 'programming.debugging-feedback', 'v1', 'capability', 'programming.functions-decomposition', 'v1'),
            ('capability', 'programming.debugging-feedback', 'v1', 'capability', 'programming.collections-iteration', 'v1')
        ) AS expected(target_type, target_key, target_version, prerequisite_type, prerequisite_key, prerequisite_version)
        EXCEPT
        SELECT target_type, target_key, target_version,
               prerequisite_type, prerequisite_key, prerequisite_version
        FROM target_prerequisite
        WHERE (target_type, target_key, target_version) IN (
            ('concept', 'programming.execution-state', 'v1'),
            ('concept', 'programming.values-expressions', 'v1'),
            ('concept', 'programming.control-flow', 'v1'),
            ('capability', 'programming.functions-decomposition', 'v1'),
            ('capability', 'programming.collections-iteration', 'v1'),
            ('capability', 'programming.debugging-feedback', 'v1')
        )
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'programming.foundation prerequisite graph conflicts with the required topology';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM transition_knowledge
        WHERE (target_type, target_key, target_version) IN (
            ('concept', 'programming.execution-state', 'v1'),
            ('concept', 'programming.values-expressions', 'v1'),
            ('concept', 'programming.control-flow', 'v1'),
            ('capability', 'programming.functions-decomposition', 'v1'),
            ('capability', 'programming.collections-iteration', 'v1'),
            ('capability', 'programming.debugging-feedback', 'v1')
        )
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'programming.foundation must not contain stack transition knowledge';
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM learning_target_stack
        WHERE (target_type, target_key, target_version) IN (
            ('concept', 'programming.execution-state', 'v1'),
            ('concept', 'programming.values-expressions', 'v1'),
            ('concept', 'programming.control-flow', 'v1'),
            ('capability', 'programming.functions-decomposition', 'v1'),
            ('capability', 'programming.collections-iteration', 'v1'),
            ('capability', 'programming.debugging-feedback', 'v1')
        )
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'programming.foundation must not contain stack-index rows';
    END IF;
END $$;

COMMIT;
